يستحثثن (form X)
# يَسْتَحْثِثْنَ (yastaḥṯiṯna) /jas.taħ.θiθ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# يُسْتَحْثَثْنَ (yustaḥṯaṯna) /jus.taħ.θaθ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
